Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenEconomicsTotalDeltaReceipt

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenEconomicsTotalDeltaReceipt
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenEconomicsTotalDeltaReceipt extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable symmetric total-delta receipt for qualified hydrotreating screening economics.

The receipt compares arbitrary qualified baseline and candidate screening cases that may differ in both physical flows and caller-owned prices. Bilinear value and feed-cost changes are split symmetrically with midpoint identities, while the qualified operating-cost change remains one aggregate contribution. The allocation is exact bookkeeping, not a causal model.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1
